package.description: An ICC compatible color management system

en-US.description: An ICC compatible color management system
en-US.longDescription: ArgyllCMS is an ICC compatible color management system, available as Open Source. It supports accurate ICC profile creation for scanners, cameras and film recorders, and calibration and profiling of displays and RGB & CMYK printers. Device Link can be created with a wide variety of advanced options, including specialized Video calibration standards and 3dLuts. Spectral sample data is supported, allowing a selection of illuminants observer types, and paper fluorescent whitener additive compensation. Profiles can also incorporate source specific gamut mappings for perceptual and saturation intents. Gamut mapping and profile linking uses the CIECAM02 appearance model, a unique gamut mapping algorithm, and a wide selection of rendering intents. It also includes code for the fastest portable 8 bit raster color conversion engine available anywhere, as well as support for fast, fully accurate 16 bit conversion. Device color gamuts can also be viewed and compared with a modern Web browser using X3DOM. Comprehensive documentation is provided for each major tool, and a general guide to using the tools for typical color management tasks is also available. A mailing list provides support for more advanced usage.
en-US.name: Argyll CMS

zh-CN.description: 兼容 ICC 的开源颜色管理系统
zh-CN.longDescription: ArgyllCMS 是一个兼容 ICC 、以开源形式提供的颜色管理系统，支持为扫描仪、相机和胶片记录仪创建精确的 ICC 配置文件，以及为显示器、RGB 和 CMYK 打印机进行校准和配置。支持创建设备链接（Device Link），并提供多种高级选项，包括专门的视频校准标准和 3D LUT。支持光谱样本数据，允许选择光源类型、观察者类型，以及纸张荧光增白剂添加物的补偿。配置文件还可以结合特定源的色域映射，用于感知（perceptual）和饱和（saturation）意图。色域映射和配置文件链接使用 CIECAM02 外观模型、独特的色域映射算法和多种渲染意图。它还包括全球最快的便携式 8 位光栅颜色转换引擎的代码，并支持快速且完全精确的 16 位转换。还可以通过支持 X3DOM 的现代 Web 浏览器查看和比较设备颜色色域。每个主要工具都提供了详尽的文档，并提供典型颜色管理任务下的使用指南。另有邮件列表为高级用途提供支持。
